experience.title: AI Implementation Manager
bullets: Owned customer onboarding end to end on Rocketlane’s professional services automation platform — discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-live — as implementation manager, solution architect, and engagement manager.
Solution architect and implementation manager for Phase 2 of NICE, an enterprise account, integrating Rocketlane with ADP, SatMetrix, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Built Atlas, an AI agent that records how each customer’s use cases were solved, so any implementation manager can ask how a problem was handled before and get an answer that is still current.

Customer Zero for Nitro, Rocketlane’s agentic AI platform — built agents for implementation documents, tested them on live projects, fed findings back to product, and drove adoption across Professional Services.

highlights.label: Atlas · Why I built it
highlights.text: Implementation managers solved customer use cases in isolation — how a problem had been solved lived in people’s heads and scattered documents. Atlas makes that knowledge searchable. Built as a Lovable app with Claude agents and custom skills, using Supermemory to index product docs, internal docs, and approved solutions so the agent retrieves only what is relevant.

highlights.label: Atlas · Capture
highlights.text: After a customer call or ticket, an agent reads the call transcript, Freshdesk tickets, Slack threads, and project documents, lists the use cases discussed, and records the solution agreed — or proposes one from Rocketlane’s product docs when none was. The implementation manager approves or revises each one, and approved solutions are saved to the knowledge base.

highlights.label: Atlas · Answer
highlights.text: When someone asks how a use case was solved, Atlas finds the approved solution and checks it against live sources — Notion, Slack, the Rocketlane instance, and current API docs — before answering. If a feature has since been retired, it explains how it was done then and how to do it now.

highlights.label: Atlas · Learn
highlights.text: Answers marked helpful are cached and returned for near-identical questions (95%+ match) without a new search. Answers marked wrong capture a reason; a validator agent classifies the failure, such as a data miss or a context miss, and queues it for an admin to fix the sources or the agent’s skills.

highlights.label: NICE · Phase 2 integrations
highlights.text: ADP for time off and time entries; SatMetrix to trigger customer surveys and write scores back to Rocketlane; ServiceNow for support tickets; Salesforce for two-way risk management and partner resource requests. Also built custom apps that show ServiceNow tickets against each project and customer.

highlights.label: Nitro · Implementation agents
highlights.text: Mapped what could be automated at each implementation stage, then built Nitro agents to draft sales-to-implementation handovers, kickoff decks, solution documents, workshop schedules, and implementation-to-CS handoffs.

experience.title: Lead, Product Implementation
bullets: Spearheaded 20 end-to-end enterprise CMMS/SaaS rollouts for mid-to-large clients — full lifecycle ownership from scoping through post-go-live support.
Facilitated client workshops with executives and operational teams; translated requirements into BRDs, solution designs, and WBS-based project plans.
Engineered and tested SaaS configurations tailored to each client, driving adoption and smooth maintenance operations.
Acted as the internal voice of the customer — bridging clients with product, engineering, and design to drive continuous improvements.

highlights.label: Key initiative
highlights.text: Conceptualized a use-case-driven implementation framework with complexity scoring and effort models — enabling pre-sales to scope accurately, auto-calculate timelines, and cut BRD/UAT ambiguity.

highlights.label: Revenue impact
highlights.text: Identified unaccounted scope-change efforts and built a tracking mechanism. Collaborated with Sales to introduce pre-purchased Professional Services credits — converting informal changes into billable units.

highlights.label: Global delivery
highlights.text: Travelled on-site to Saudi Arabia for a half-million dollar engagement and to the UK for MHA — field requirement gathering, stakeholder workshops, and go-live training across UK, US, and Middle East.

highlights.label: Pilot → Enterprise conversions
highlights.text: 4 of 5 pilots converted to full-scale enterprise rollouts — through structured discovery, early value demonstration, and deep stakeholder alignment during the pilot phase, driving $350K+ in expansion value.

highlights.label: Business Analysis
highlights.text: Owned the end-to-end requirements lifecycle — from scoping workshops with client stakeholders to documenting BRDs with solution designs. Worked cross-functionally with integration, product, and engineering teams to tailor configurations that best fit each client’s operational workflow.

highlights.label: Integration & Configuration
highlights.text: Scoped and defined integration requirements across SSO (SAML/SCIM) and third-party platforms including Xero, CorrigoPro, Equiem, Wooqer, Bill.com, SiteFotos, and SFG20. Validated API feasibility via Postman and vendor documentation, determined integration patterns (polling vs webhook), and authored integration requirement documents for the engineering team.

experience.title: Senior Catalog Specialist
bullets: Managed and resolved catalog and procurement defects for Amazon Fresh, Amazon Pantry, and Prime Now — directly improving operational efficiency.
Designed a defect prioritisation framework using product forecasts, inventory value, and glance views — yielding an estimated $230K in monthly savings.
Streamlined defect reduction by identifying SOP gaps, reducing invalid case assignments between support teams by ~50 per day.

summary: Implementation leader with 5+ years owning SaaS implementations end to end — as AI Implementation Manager at Rocketlane and Implementation Lead at Facilio, for customers across the UK, US, and Middle East. Runs discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-live. Hands-on with REST APIs, webhooks, SSO, and integrations with Salesforce, ServiceNow, and ADP. Builds AI agents, like Atlas, that capture how each implementation problem was solved and make that knowledge reusable across the team.
